{{Top|leg}}
A '''truth meter''' was a portable device used to measure the responses of an individual in an attempt to detect deception and falsehoods. They were not very accurate. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hawra]] of the [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on [[Lotide]] used one.
